scope: Sanitized representative projection keys derived from the published case study, not a production schema export. Four interactive roles are a subset of the six-role architecture.

roles.label: Owner / Admin
roles.boundary: Administrative and operational oversight; guarded commands.

roles.label: Manager
roles.boundary: Authorized operational scope; no implicit account administration.

roles.label: Observer
roles.boundary: Read-only management views; no management mutation.

roles.label: Head Employee
roles.boundary: Assigned work and configured team supervision.

roles.label: Client
roles.boundary: Own shipments, public milestones, own vault and addressed requests.

field_provenance.internal_drafts: case-studies/atg.md: Client projection excludes internal drafts (representative key)
field_provenance.staff_document_requests: case-studies/atg.md: Client projection excludes staff-only document requests (representative key)
field_provenance.account_administration: case-studies/atg.md: Manager is not an implicit account administrator (representative key)

model_scope: The stage order is the published normalized freight view, not a universal production graph. Submit/approve/reject follow the public reduced task_move contract; role-to-action mapping is a representative allowlist for this explorer. Database RLS is not executed here.
